items.title: 63477_Joe Darensbourg oral history interview
items.q: 'Look, Scanley, you can stay here and clap you hands around the band,'

ctx.x: named Scanley(?) something. And who else on trombone...? They had a tuba player, too, but I can't think of his name. We wasn't together that long either, anyway.
You said when you got to Los Angeles, Ory had just left.
